claims.claim: Rajnath Singh launched Fleet Support Ship Surya at Hindustan Shipyard in Visakhapatnam on Tuesday and laid the keel for FSS-5.
claims.episode_span: Singh on Tuesday launched the Indian Navy’s first indigenously built Fleet Support Ship, FSS-1 Surya
claims.source_title: Rajnath Singh launches Navy’s first indigenous fleet support ship ‘Surya’ at Visakhapatnam
claims.supporting_quote: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched the Indian Navy’s first indigenously built Fleet Support Ship FSS-1 named Surya and laid the keel for the fifth vessel of the series FSS-5 at Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL) in Visakhapatnam on Tuesday (October 6, 2026).

claims.claim: Surya displaces about 43,500 tonnes and was built with 82 percent indigenous content.
claims.source_title: Rajnath Singh launches Navy’s first indigenous fleet support ship ‘Surya’ at Visakhapatnam
claims.supporting_quote: The 43,500-tonne vessel built with 82% Indian content at Hindustan Shipyard can refuel and resupply several warships at sea at once

claims.claim: Surya is 223.6 metres long, 31.5 metres wide, draws 9.3 metres and has a top speed of 20 knots.
claims.episode_span: Surya is 223.6 metres long and 31.5 metres wide, with a draught of 9.3 metres and a top speed of 20 knots.
claims.source_title: Rajnath Singh launches Navy’s first indigenous fleet support ship ‘Surya’ at Visakhapatnam
claims.supporting_quote: Surya is 223.6 metres long and 31.5 metres wide with a draught of 9.3 metres. It displaces about 43,500 tonnes and has a top speed of 20 knots.

claims.claim: Surya carries 20,000 tonnes of diesel, 2,500 tonnes of aviation fuel, 1,000 tonnes of fresh water and 250 tonnes of feed water.
claims.episode_span: It carries 20,000 tonnes of low-sulphur high-speed diesel, 2,500 tonnes of aviation turbine fuel
claims.source_title: Rajnath Singh launches Navy’s first indigenous fleet support ship ‘Surya’ at Visakhapatnam
claims.supporting_quote: It carries 20,000 tonnes of low-sulphur high-speed diesel, 2,500 tonnes of aviation turbine fuel, 1,000 tonnes of fresh water and 250 tonnes of feed water

claims.claim: Slipway No. 4 is 235 metres long and 37.5 metres wide, and a 300-tonne Goliath crane was inaugurated.
claims.episode_span: Singh inaugurated modernised Slipway No. 4, 235 metres long and 37.5 metres wide, and a 300-tonne Goliath crane
claims.source_title: Rajnath Singh launches Navy’s first indigenous fleet support ship ‘Surya’ at Visakhapatnam
claims.supporting_quote: Mr. Singh also inaugurated HSL’s newly modernised Slipway No. 4, which is 235 metres long and 37.5 metres wide, and a 300-tonne Goliath crane.

claims.claim: Malaysian authorities seized 72 servers with advanced AI chips valued at about 52.9 million ringgit, or 12.5 million US dollars, at Kuala Lumpur International Airport in June.
claims.episode_span: Malaysian authorities seized 72 servers at Kuala Lumpur International Airport
claims.source_title: Can ASEAN continue to reap economic benefits from the US-China rivalry?
claims.supporting_quote: In June, Malaysian law enforcement authorities seized 72 servers at Kuala Lumpur International Airport that were being smuggled out of the country and contained advanced artificial intelligence (AI) chips, with the shipment valued at around 52.9 million ringgit (US$12.5 million).

claims.claim: Vietnam’s exports to the United States rose from 49.1 billion US dollars in 2018 to 193.9 billion in 2025, and Thailand’s exports to the United States tripled in that period.
claims.episode_span: Vietnam’s exports to the United States rose from 49.1 billion US dollars in 2018 to 193.9 billion in 2025
claims.source_title: Can ASEAN continue to reap economic benefits from the US-China rivalry?
claims.supporting_quote: Between 2018 and 2025, Vietnam’s total exports to the US surged from US$49.1 billion to US$193.9 billion, almost quadrupling. Over the same period, Thailand’s total exports to the US also tripled.

claims.claim: South Korea holds 52 death-row inmates with an average age of 58.7, and has not executed anyone since December 30, 1997.

claims.supporting_quote: With executions suspended in South Korea for nearly 30 years, 52 death row inmates are currently being held in domestic correctional facilities, the justice ministry said Tuesday.
